what: Issue #136, PR #138: the backup unit's status written after every run, carried by the existing Alloy agent to Grafana Cloud, and three alert rules over it. Measured on the pilot's VPS before merge (the status writer from the PR's candidate tree, Alloy recreated alone), with a controlled failure of the real unit, the first unattended timer run after it, and the alert path proven end to end in CI. Grafana's own evaluation and e-mail are not proven: the rules are not loaded in Grafana yet.

what_counts.verified: a dump whose receipt describes it: receipt format, file name, the dump object's sha256 equal to the manifest's, and the manifest object recorded. Its time is the dump's own timestamp, from its name, not the time of the copy
what_counts.not_verified: a dump with a manifest and no receipt (local only, or PATHABLE_OFFSITE=skip), or a receipt that does not describe its dump
what_counts.labels: job=pathable-backup, instance=waterloo-pilot, and stage on one series (none, dump, upload, verification, timeout, other). No bucket, object key, path, credential or database value is in any label or value; node_textfile_mtime_seconds, whose file label is a path, is dropped by Alloy before remote write

alert_rules.file: infra/vps/grafana/backup.rules.yaml, group pathable-backup, evaluated every 1 m
rules: PathAbleBackupNotVerifiedInS3 (critical): no backup verified in S3 for over 26 h, or none ever; this is how a timer that never fires shows up
PathAbleBackupStatusMissing (warning): no status for 30 min, or Alloy cannot read a status file
alert_rules.promtool: prom/prometheus:v3.15.1 promtool test rules: the 8 backup cases pass (failure and recovery at upload; verification stage; a stopped timer firing at 27h10m and not at 26h50m with PathAbleBackupFailed quiet; a late daily run not alerting; never verified; silence firing at 41 min and not at 35 min; a 2-minute gap not alerting; a scrape error)
alert_rules.mutation: 7 rule mutants, each caught by promtool; 11 mutants of the writer, Alloy config and unit, each caught by the Linux pytest suite. Run before bf66758, whose str() hardening changed one mutated line

end_to_end.what: infra/vps/tests/backup-alert-e2e.sh: backup_metrics.py writes the status, Alloy (grafana/alloy:v1.21.2, uid 473, all capabilities dropped, status volume read-only) reads and remote-writes it, Prometheus v3.15.1 evaluates the rules, Alertmanager v0.28.1 delivers to a webhook. Shortened: Alloy's backup scrape 60 s to 10 s and the rule interval 1 m to 5 s. Seconds are from the status change to the webhook's receipt
